content.title: Good Friday Liturgy of the Lord’s Passion – April 3, 2026
content.text: Livestream Broadcast | 4/3/26 | Good Friday Liturgy of the Lord’s Passion Presider: His Eminence Christophe Cardinal Pierre, Apostolic Nuncio to the United States Celebrant: Reverend Monsignor Walter R. Rossi, Rector of the Basilica Cantor & Organist of the Basilica First Reading: Isaiah 52:13—53:12 Responsorial Psalm: 31 Second Reading: Hebrews 4:14-16; 5:7-9 Gospel: John 18:1—19:42 ------------------------------------------------------------------ Mass readings: Good Friday https://bible.usccb.org/bible/reading... To support this ministry: https://secure.nationalshrine.org/sit... Join us for Sunday Mass at the Basilica of the National Shrine of the Immaculate Conception in Washington, D.C. This Catholic Mass Today is the Holy Mass for Good Friday Liturgy of the Lord’s Passion celebrated on April 3rd 2026 at 2:30 PM for a choral prelude and the Liturgy of the Lord’s Passion. Prior to the liturgy, the Choir of the Basilica will present: Meditations on the Passion. You can view the program for Mass here: https://www.nationalshrine.org/wp-con... Experience the beauty of the Eucharist in this Catholic Sunday Mass livestream from the National Shrine, also known as the DC National Shrine. Whether you're searching for Mass Today, or additional Catholic Mass Online, this LiveStream Service brings the Divine Liturgy directly to you. This Catholic Mass on the Internet is part of the Daily Mass tradition at the Shrine, offering spiritual nourishment through the Catholic Church's sacred rites.
